Chapter 111: Friend Rival, Care to Buy a Game of "Killers of the Three Kingdoms"?

On Friday afternoon, Chen Guiliang skipped class again.

He had invited Senior Sister Ao to his company, to see if he could talk her into joining.

As for the 14 counselors of the Yuanpei Program, including Senior Brother Long Xiang, they already had their own life plans. They were either staying on for graduate studies or going abroad, and for the time being, had no interest in getting involved in business.

Especially for those who wanted to go into politics, there was a clear path: graduate studies — staying at the university — being seconded to the Youth League — taking up a post at the grassroots level — steady promotion.

"This place of yours is quite good, just that the office is too crowded," Ao Yanchen commented.

Chen Guiliang smiled and said, "As long as you join, you'll be the head manager. By the end of this year at the latest, the company will be able to move into the Science and Technology Park Building."

Ao Yanchen was no naive simpleton. "Head manager my ass. This place is full of tech staff, I can't command any of them. If I come, I'll definitely just be an errand girl, doing all the dirty and tiring work. I estimate that before we even move into the building, I'll also be responsible for contacting renovators and purchasing office supplies."

"The more capable one is, the more one works. How can a founding member not be tired? If you do a good job, I'll give you stock options before the venture capital comes in," Chen Guiliang continued to paint a pretty picture.

Ao Yanchen asked, "Not a single finance person?"

"You can take on that role concurrently for now," Chen Guiliang said.

Ao Yanchen was speechless. "Shouldn't the accountant and cashier be separate at least?"

"Isn't it because I trust you?"

Chen Guiliang said, "I'll be the general ledger accountant, and you can be the subsidiary ledger accountant and cashier."

Ao Yanchen completely understood. Apart from the programmers' work, she had to fill in wherever there was a shortage of people. Even when customer service was too busy, she might have to temporarily act as a customer service representative.

To be the purchaser, accountant, and cashier for two companies at the same time sounded nice, like it was a sign of trust. But given the company's current state, if she bought a desk for even a slightly higher price, it would be easily noticeable.

Don't even think about any kickbacks.

"Capitalist!" Ao Yanchen gritted her teeth.

Chen Guiliang extended his right hand. "How about a handshake? Pao Ge never goes back on their word!"

Ao Yanchen ultimately extended her hand, but she was unwilling to lose her imposing manner. "The day I'm not happy working here, I'll leave anytime."

"If you leave midway, the options will be automatically forfeited," Chen Guiliang reminded with a grin.

"Who cares about your measly options?"

Although she said that, she was still full of anticipation.

Previously, she had helped promote "Killers of the Three Kingdoms" at Tsinghua and Beihang. In the beginning, she hardly made any money, but now she could see a little sales commission. Moreover, the temporary restocking by tricycle had now become scheduled restocking by minivan.

Seeing Xiaonei Network today, Ao Yanchen felt that Chen Guiliang's company had potential.

The more tired she was as the head manager now, the more influence she would have in the company in the future.

Chen Guiliang was also very happy. After tricking Senior Sister Ao into joining, he no longer had to deal with many of the miscellaneous tasks.

"Let me go over the work."

"Hurry up."

Twenty minutes later, Senior Sister Ao already wanted to hit someone.

She also had to serve as the assistant product manager for both "Killers of the Three Kingdoms" and Xiaonei Network, and even had to personally lead part-timers to do on-the-ground promotion.

The renovation and procurement for the new office were indeed also her responsibility. This weekend, she would have to contact renovators, find someone for interior design, compare renovation prices, compare material prices, compare office supply prices...

After explaining all the work, Chen Guiliang slipped away directly.

Ao Yanchen was making a work plan in a small notebook. As she wrote, she suddenly looked up. "Is there anything he and I haven't made clear?"

Guo Feng, with his hands on the keyboard, stared at the monitor and said, "You forgot to discuss your salary."

"Fuck!"

Senior Sister Ao slapped her thigh hard.

Chen Guiliang strolled to the East Gate, waiting leisurely by the roadside for the bus.

Having someone willing to share the workload was truly a delightful thing.

However, did I just forget something?

Sigh, if I can't remember it right away, forget it. It's probably not anything important.

Enjoying a rare moment of leisure, Chen Guiliang's mind was at peace, finally returning to the state he was in just after his rebirth.

He took a bus, transferred to the subway at Wudaokou, transferred again at Xizhimen, and then switched to a bus to go to the Capital University of Economics and Business.

He had to make these continuous transfers because it was a Friday afternoon, and taking a taxi the whole way would definitely get stuck in traffic.

He dozed off the entire way, pretty much well-rested by the time he got off.

By the time he arrived at the entrance of the Capital University of Economics and Business, the sky was already growing dark.

Chen Guiliang had come once before to see Bian Guanyue off for her enrollment. He strolled through the campus from memory, and when he couldn't remember, he would just grab a student to ask for directions.

In front of the female dormitory building, more and more students were gathering to watch.

A few boys were setting up candles, using the faint light in front of the building to form a heart shape as night fell.

One of the boys was even carrying a guitar, dressed in a full leather outfit, exuding a very artistic air.

"Who is this guy?"

"Don't know."

"He's in a band, the lead singer. His name is... what was it again?"

"I know, a sophomore senior from the Finance major. His name is Peng Haoran, and his family is very rich. I heard that the sidecar motorcycle he usually rides is custom-made and costs tens of thousands, and it has a Jing-A license plate!"

"How do you know so much?"

"His band is famous, they even performed at the freshmen welcome party."

As the crowd in front of the dormitory building grew, the noise also got louder.

Inside the dormitory building, girls from various rooms started peeking out of their windows one after another to watch the excitement.

Bian Guanyue was sending a text message: "Are you here?"

"Almost."

"That senior is setting up candles in front of the dorm, and it seems like he's going to sing. You better not get into a fight."

"Yeah, you just stay in your dorm. Don't go down and get tangled up with him."

"Okay, I'll be waiting for you."

In the dorm room, her four roommates were leaning against the window, looking outside.

Bian Guanyue was sitting cross-legged on her bed, texting.

Another girl was browsing a BBS on her Apple laptop.

This girl's name was Lin Ruonan, from the southern coastal region. Actually, her name was originally Lin Ruonan (男 - male), until her younger brother was born, her parents agreed to change her name.

Lin Ruonan's family was quite wealthy, and she competed with Bian Guanyue in every aspect.

When she found out that Bian Guanyue's Apple laptop was more expensive, she also got a new Apple laptop, an even more expensive model.

Bian Guanyue was prettier than her, so she practiced her makeup skills every day and chose more beautiful brand-name clothes.

It was all about being number one, number one in the dorm, number one in the class.

After dressing up like this, there were even boys in the class who thought Lin Ruonan could be named the department belle.

"Xiao Bian, come and see."

The dorm leader, leaning on the window, turned her head and shouted, "He's lighting the candles now, and they've spelled out 'iloveyou' inside the heart!"

Another roommate said, "If it were me, I'd say yes. Senior Peng is very handsome, and he's super talented."

"Exactly, just say yes to him," another roommate urged.

Bian Guanyue said, "I have a boyfriend."

Lin Ruonan sneered, "Heh."

"What are you 'heh'-ing about?" The roommate in the bunk below Bian Guanyue really couldn't stand Lin Ruonan.

Lin Ruonan said, "This is called playing hard to get. The more you put on airs, the more men will flock to you. If you were to foolishly agree like them, men wouldn't cherish you at all. Especially those band guys, they change their minds very quickly. They'll dump you after sleeping with you a few times."

"No way, this Senior Peng is very devoted."

"I've asked around among the seniors. This Senior Peng is devoted to everyone. But his devotion has an expiration date; once it's past, it resets to zero. But he's such a Casanova that the girlfriends he dumps don't even resent him much. It's often the ex-girlfriend and the current girlfriend fighting over him."

"That impressive?"

"Lin Ruonan, don't tell me you also like Senior Peng and are badmouthing him because you want to steal him?"

"Me, like this kind of guy? You think I'm as stupid as you?"

"Who are you calling stupid?"

"Yeah, watch your mouth!"

Lin Ruonan frequently made sarcastic remarks to everyone in the dorm and had pretty much offended all her roommates.

But Bian Guanyue looked at Lin Ruonan with confusion, not understanding why this person was warning her to be careful of a scumbag.

"What are you looking at me for?" Lin Ruonan asked.

Bian Guanyue smiled and said, "Nothing."

Lin Ruonan put down her laptop, squeezed to the window to look outside, and saw that all the candles were lit. They were plugging an electric guitar into an amplifier. She scoffed in her hometown dialect, "Chi sin!"

The song Peng Haoran was going to sing today was "Cinderella." This was his go-to song every time he pursued a girl.

With his handsome looks, beautiful voice, and generous spending, he had always been successful in picking up girls.

This freshman girl this year was a bit hard to get. He had been chasing her for over a month with no progress.

This only fueled his fighting spirit!

Peng Haoran nodded at his bandmates, who immediately took their positions.

Just then, a boy with a backpack came over. "Hello, excuse me."

Peng Haoran was about to start playing and singing, and getting interrupted out of nowhere made him very annoyed. "What do you want?"

Chen Guiliang forced a handshake with a broad smile. "I've come all the way from Peking University because I heard there's an awesome band at the Capital University of Economics and Business."

Come all the way from Peking University because he heard of them?

Peng Haoran's anger vanished in an instant. This was a die-hard fan.

"I hope I haven't found the wrong people. Which band are you?" Chen Guiliang asked.

Peng Haoran said, "We are the Soul Hunter band."

"Then I'm not wrong, Soul Hunter is exactly who I'm looking for," Chen Guiliang praised sincerely. "That name sounds incredible just hearing it. Your music must be able to capture people's souls!"

Peng Haoran said smugly, "I came up with the band name myself. You have a good sense, you immediately grasped the deep meaning behind my name choice. Are you also in a band? Or are you a fan from another school?"

"I'm a startup entrepreneur," Chen Guiliang said.

"Huh?" Peng Haoran was a bit confused.

Chen Guiliang put down his backpack and took out a set of "Killers of the Three Kingdoms." "This is my product. Friend, care to buy a set?"

Peng Haoran asked, "Are you... a salesman?"

Chen Guiliang showed his Peking University student ID and handed over his business card. "Not a salesman. I just think your band is particularly awesome and fits the vibe of 'Killers of the Three Kingdoms' players perfectly. So I couldn't help but recommend it to you."

Peng Haoran was silent for a long time, then squeezed out one word: "Scram!"

"Don't curse even if you're not buying. Business may not work out, but goodwill remains."

Chen Guiliang could only put away the "Killers of the Three Kingdoms," put on his backpack again, and shouted towards the girls' dormitory building, "Guanguan, come down for dinner!"
